# Do NOT report security issues here

Security vulnerabilities filed as public GitHub issues expose all neothd users
before a fix is available.

**Please follow the private disclosure process described in [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md).**

If you are unsure whether your finding is a security issue, err on the side of
private disclosure.

Thank you for helping keep neothd secure.
